subject.title: feat: show OpenClaw sessions in Codex

question: Should the official `@openclaw/codex` package ship native collection metadata that is not implemented in the current public Codex source?
rationale: The standard plugin surfaces are supported, but adopting an experimental external host contract and making this package the permanent native UI owner requires maintainer intent that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Gate collections, ship fallback
options.body: Ship the supported global app and enable native collections only for a documented or pinned Codex capability after live validation.

options.title: Accept experimental coupling
options.body: Include the metadata now with explicit ownership of unreleased host compatibility and recurring exact-host proof.

options.title: Wait for public support
options.body: Pause native distribution until Codex publishes a stable collection contract that can be independently tested.

recommendation.title: Gate collections, ship fallback
recommendation.body: Ship the supported global app and enable native collections only for a documented or pinned Codex capability after live validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent merged history in the Codex extension and is the strongest available owner for the cross-product ownership decision.
